correctness.rationale: The height-two incidence radical J contains only minimal-to-maximal edges, so J^2=0 and units are diagonal torus T=(F_q^*)^v semidirect an additive edge vector. Conjugation by 1+b removes precisely edges with unequal diagonal endpoint labels. On equal-label edges, support S is a torus-orbit invariant and each fixed-support class multiplicity is (q-1)^(|S|-v+c(S)). For connected unicyclic G the only support with cycle rank one contains the whole unique cycle, so summing supports yields the stated cycle-correction term. The color-transfer matrix I+11^T has eigenvalues q and 1; each bridge contributes q, giving k(U)=q^v+(q-2)q^(v-ell+1), including q=2 (abelian). For fixed q>2 the positive correction strictly identifies ell when v is known. Independent small q=2,3,4 edge-support orbit enumeration agrees on C4 and pendant-C4; finite verification is not the infinite proof.
